selectedSources.author: Affaan Mustafa / ECC
selectedSources.license: MIT; original notice retained in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
borrowed: Cross-platform semantics, keyboard and assistive-technology coverage; connect fields and errors and check real native settings.
local_choices: Use platform-specific references and existing components, with no React-only examples or fixed accessibility API mapping.
Correct AA/AAA focus classification and target-size scope against primary standards; do not turn every error into an alert.

selectedSources.author: Matthew Blode
selectedSources.license: MIT; original notice retained in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
borrowed: Treat accessibility as completing the task, including reachable states, consequences, errors and recovery.
local_choices: Keep an accessibility specialist rather than the donor product-design router, rule registry, severity rubric or aesthetics scope.

selectedSources.author: Matthew Blode
selectedSources.license: MIT; original notice retained in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
borrowed: Use observed keyboard and focus paths, real hit regions, scoped automated scans and explicit missing evidence.
local_choices: verify and the local recipe retain environment and execution ownership. No fixed browser CLI or mandatory probe matrix.
Reject blanket third-party exclusion, pixel-difference focus verdicts, 44px as a universal AA floor, and viewport-only zoom claims.

selectedSources.author: web-quality-skills, distributed by GSD (Lex Christopherson)
selectedSources.license: MIT; original notice retained in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
borrowed: Cover content alternatives, input, timing, understandable forms, and the limits of automated and source-only audits.
local_choices: Use WCAG 2.2 with precise exceptions, not the donor abbreviated 2.1 checklist or its obsolete Parsing criterion.
Correct pt versus px large-text thresholds; omit language-specific snippets, global package installation, fixed severity and zero-score certification.

selectedSources.author: Addy Osmani
selectedSources.license: MIT; original notice retained in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
borrowed: Select keyboard, screen reader, visual and form checks; preserve design-system context and meaningful error and loading states.
local_choices: Reuse selected accessibility coverage only, not the UI-building workflow, aesthetic rules or component-size limits.
Correct large-text units and keyboard/target-size exceptions; avoid the incomplete dialog snippet, mandatory focus movement on any content change and automatic legal claims.

selectedSources.author: GitHub CLI maintainers
selectedSources.license: MIT; original notice retained in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
borrowed: Terminal accessibility can require stable prompts, readable progress and configurable color rather than cursor redraws and animation.
local_choices: Use as a conditional design reference for terminal work; do not prescribe GitHub CLI settings or mutate user configuration.

decision: Derive rather than install competing generic auditors. Five repository donors supply six selected source feeds. W3C and platform documentation resolve technical requirements; verify retains environment ownership.
limitations: A keyword hit is not a relevant or fully inspected source; inaccessible/inapplicable matches were screened out.
Source adoption does not install the entire upstream skill or validate all of its examples.
Some sources contain incorrect units, levels or absolute rules; these are corrected rather than inherited.
Implicit host activation, installation and broad real-world assistive-technology compatibility require separate evidence.
